Rust rewrite of Coder backend; target full Go route/behavior parity (72/229, 31%). `docs/parity-matrix.md` is source of truth. `coder/` is read-only Go reference; if empty, run `git submodule update --init coder`.

Do not over-engineer a solution when a simple one is possible. Keep edits minimal. If you want an exception to ANY rule, you MUST stop and get permission first.
**NEVER modify any file under `coder/`** — it is read-only reference material
**NEVER commit changes to `coder/`**
**Do not** add dependency versions in individual crate `Cargo.toml` files.
`unwrap_used = "deny"` — Use `?` or explicit error handling, never `.unwrap()`
`expect_used = "deny"` — Same; no `.expect()` either
`panic = "deny"` — No `panic!()`
`todo = "deny"` — No `todo!()` macros
`dbg_macro = "deny"` — No `dbg!()` left in code
`unsafe_code = "forbid"` — No `unsafe` blocks at all.
Use `thiserror` for defining error enums. Propagate with `?`. Never use `.unwrap()` or `.expect().
**No `.unwrap()` / `.expect()` / `panic!()` / `todo!()` / `dbg!()`** — The workspace denies these at the lint level. CI and `cargo clippy` will reject them.
**No `unsafe` code** — Forbidden workspace-wide.
**No per-crate dependency versions** — Always use `workspace = true` references.
**Do not modify files under `coder/`** — This is the vendored Go reference. Treat as read-only.
**Do not create separate `tests/` directories** — Use `#[cfg(test)]` in-file.

Port routes by checking `docs/parity-matrix.md`, Go handlers (`coder/coderd/<file>.go`), SDK models (`coder/codersdk/<file>.go`), and SQL (`coder/coderd/database/queries/<file>.sql`); implement Rust types, DB/migrations, handlers, and in-file tests. Handlers: `crates/coder-server/src/app.rs`; tests alongside source. Update parity tool for new routes.

Rust 2024, MSRV 1.85, toolchain 1.94.0; Axum 0.8, PostgreSQL/sqlx 0.8, Tokio, serde, tracing. Workspace dependencies in root `Cargo.toml` `[workspace.dependencies]`; crates use `dep.workspace = true`.
